name: Artificial
source:
You don't remember anything. Not your name, not the name of the man in front of you. Can you trust him? Why does he seem so sad? And what is he doing with that screwdriver anyways?

[From [url=https://saelinstudios.itch.io/artificial]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你什么都不记得了。不是你的名字，也不是你面前这个人的名字。你能相信他吗？为什么他看起来这么悲伤？他到底用那把螺丝刀做什么呢？

[来自[url=https://saelinstudios.itch.io/artificial]Itch.io[/url]]
